notes.title: Update to v1.0.0.4
notes.content:
Pathfinders... we have some great news for you! 

We're keeping working hard on Ashwalkers and thanks to your precious feedback we're able to make the game better day by day. We added features you'll love for sure and fixed some bugs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626099/910d7a58c11c43c91aa98eae19b85a73cd8795f0.png[/img]

Here's the complete patch note: 

[list]
[b][*] Added double-click to run in Custom mode (unlocked after completing your first run).

[*] Added click-and-hold to speed up / skip the cutscenes (unlocked after completing your first run).

[*] Added run animations for each character.

[*] Added sound effects for camp events.

[*] Fixed a display bug where the zone names in the badge's panel were mixed up. 

[*] Fixed a display bug where the run's stats appeared as profile's stats (and vice versa).[/b]
[/list]

Yep, RUNNING is now possible in Ashwalkers, but only if you completed your first run on the game! 

How many endings have you already discovered?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273690/Ashwalkers/

notes.title: Ashwalkers Update 1.0.0.3 is live!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

We read all your bug reports and feedback and we're very grateful about your help and support. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626099/17855c32b15bcf5cc62c3cbf6ac369a704803a34.png[/img]

Here's the list of the fixed issues and changes in this new update:

[list]
[b][*] Fixed an issue that was blocking the download of the game for some players. 

[*] Fixed the trigger of some events (Mine and Observatory's basement), which were leading player to feel blocked.

[*] Fixed Traditional Chinese for encyclopedia.

[*] Fixed dialogues soft-locking the game in Traditional Chinese.

[*] Fixed Simplified and Traditional Chinese font. 

[*] Fixed a bug where "Display mode" and "Vsync" options were not initialized correctly.

[*] Fixed achievements' unlocking for "The Expedition, "The Journey", "The Exodus", "The Value of our Lifes", "The Abyss", "The Sleeping Dome" and "The Ashwalkers". 

[*] Backpack gauge now indicates the right value from game's start.

[*] Addition of the revision of the Simplified Chinese translation.

[*] Damping reduced to 0 for camera in subway carriage (was causing camera to clip in roof).

[*] Exploration is now available during tutorial in camp. 

[*] Added loading animation at game's launch.

[*] Changed credits scrolling speed.

[*] Small visual fixes around the environment.[/b]
[/list]


Thank you again for your feedback which is very important to us!

notes.title: "Cendres" rises from the ashes to become Ashwalkers
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=Y6rxrhAvozA;full][/previewyoutube]

200 years after an apocalypse caused by a geological disaster that wiped out the majority of humanity, a group of survivors – The Squad – sets out into a desolated world. They are looking for the Dome of Domes, a safe haven for their people. To find it, they go through a deadly journey in the hostile wilderness.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626099/a2c486df27fa4ce5cc6e94732dca5b11a87636b4.jpg[/img]

Ashwalkers is a post-apocalyptic narrative survival game in which every decision the player makes has a direct impact on the story. Each time an obstacle is met, the player will have to choose a decision among four proposals, each linked to a member of The Squad: the brave captain of the group Petra, the pragmatic fighter Sinh, the young optimistic scholar Kali and the cautious scout Nadir.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626099/7f491eef0597fee7cb34e2ce0c6bbd890124699b.jpg[/img]

[h3]How will you react to the numerous ethical dilemmas has in store for you? Which one of the 34 possible endings will you reach? Find out in Spring 2021![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626099/e89a50fea9f58222128ba41766b6ca1b2d9b94e0.jpg[/img]

Can’t wait to play? A public demo of Ashwalkers will be available during [b]the Steam Spring Festival from February 3 to February 9, 2021![/b] It will feature the first area of the game, which will put you directly through the post-apocalyptic world without rules or judgment that makes the decor and the universe of this game.

We will be eager to hear your reactions and your feedback on this first overview!

[i]A survival journey through a harsh world without rules or judgement. Only your choices matters in the face of moral dilemmas. Manage your party, food & equipment in this non-linear narrative survival sim with 34 possible endings.[/i]
Add Ashwalkers to your wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1273690/Ashwalkers/

notes.title: Cendres : A new thrilling survival journey!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38626099/bf1766e2d92bf96e9c3b62bdab88fcaf2d5f4d23.jpg[/img]

Hello,

Yesterday, a brand new game was announced by IGN : Cendres, a post-apocalyptic survival game set in a world devastated by a volcanic eruption. The player controls a squad of four survivors facing the dangers of the wilds in order to reach a dome - one of the last shelters under which humanity can prosper. 

Cendres is a thrilling game in which survival is your main goal; every encounter, every event comes with a list of choices - each tied to one of the four characters - that you pick from in order to advance in the game. You can choose to run, to fight, to explore, to loot and many others; each of these branches in the intricate narrative of the game comes with the fear to make the wrong choice, the temptation to give in to greed and the excitement to “win” these events. This branching narrative makes every run of the game different from the others - there are 34 endings that you can reach.

Cendres is definitely a game that will keep you on the edge of your seat.[b] It will be coming to Steam in 2021![/b]

[previewyoutube=k0MvEqdmuxc;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k0MvEqdmuxc[/previewyoutube]
